basic_details.job_title: TISS Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for Senior Research Officer, Senior Documentation and Communication Officer Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Centre for Criminology and Justice, School of Social Work, Tata Institute of Social Sciences (TISS), Mumbai invites online applications for 2 contractual positions of Senior Research Officer and Senior Documentation and Communication Officer under its field action project "Prayas" on a consolidated remuneration of Rs 70,000/- per month for a duration of 12 months. Candidates holding an M.Phil or Ph.D. (or nearing Ph.D. completion) with at least 3 years of relevant experience in criminal justice or social work with marginalised populations can submit their online application through the off

how_to_apply: Candidates are requested to apply online through the link (Apply Now) provided along with this advertisement on the Institute's website at www.tiss.ac.in
Candidate must provide their Gmail ID in Online Application Form.
Candidates must submit separate application for each position applied for.

The application fee of Rs. 500/- be paid online. The application fee for SC/ST/PWD candidates will be Rs. 125/- if they attach the required certificate to the online application form. The women applicants are waived from payment of application fees.
Candidates are requested to take a print of the acknowledgment of the online application and keep it for future reference.
important_instructions: The position is unreserved, but candidates belonging to the reserved category can apply. Candidate must submit separate application for each position applied for. The candidate under employment must produce a 'No Objection Certificate' from their employer to appear for an interview. No TA/DA is payable for appearing for the interview. No queries or correspondence regarding the issue of call letter for interview/selection of candidates for the position will be entertained at any stage and canvassing in any form is strictly prohibited and will lead to the candidate being debarred from consideration for the position. The shortlisted candidates are requested to bring XEROX copies of the relevant Certificates of Educational Qualifications, Work Experience & ID Proof (Self attested) along with Original documents for Verification at the time of Personal Interview. The selected candidate would be required to join within 15 days of selection.

content_sections.heading: About TISS Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Tata Institute of Social Sciences, located at V.N. Purav Marg, Deonar, Mumbai 400 088, is declared as a Deemed to be University under Section 3 of the UGC Act 1956 and functions as a grant-in-aid Institute under the Ministry of Education, Government of India. "Prayas" is a field action project initiated in the year 1990 under the Centre for Criminology and Justice, School of Social Work, TISS, Mumbai. It aims at the socio-legal and economic rehabilitation of persons who are at risk of being criminalized, exploited for commercial sex, and those in destitute states.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notification announces a total of 2 unreserved vacancies on a contractual basis for a duration of 12 months at the TISS Mumbai Campus. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? Test Yourself! 25 Questions · 20 Minutes · Instant Score Take Today's Free Quiz →

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The position is unreserved, but candidates belonging to the reserved category can apply. Applicants must meet the educational qualification, experience, and language requirements stated for each post. The institute reserves the right to relax any of the qualification/ experience/ age limit in exceptional cases, or in case of person already holding analogous position in Government Department/ Research and Academic Institution/ Industry.

rows.qualification_experience_required: Candidates with a M.Phil or Ph.D. or those nearing completion of their Ph.D. are preferred. At least 3 years of relevant experience in the field of criminal justice / social work with marginalised populations.
rows.desirable_skills_language: Research skills (conceptualising research, undertaking data collection and analysis, report writing and publication); good command over spoken Hindi and spoken and written English; knowledge of Marathi will be an added advantage.

rows.qualification_experience_required: Candidates with a M.Phil or Ph.D. or those nearing completion of their Ph.D. are preferred. At least 3 years of relevant experience in the field of criminal justice / social work with marginalised populations.
rows.desirable_skills_language: Excellent writing skills in English; working knowledge of Hindi and Marathi; good communication and team building skills; ability to work effectively in teams as well as independently; willingness to travel outside Mumbai, when required.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated remuneration of Rs 70,000/- per month for both positions, which is inclusive of Travelling Allowance. The engagement is purely on a contractual basis for a duration of 12 months. Selected candidates are required to join within 15 days of selection.

content_sections.heading: TISS Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Ability to work effectively in teams as well as independently. Should be willing to travel within and between states. Ability to meet deadlines. Documentation skills. Knowledge about publication processes. Expertise of qualitative and quantitative research software. Conducting field-based research and data collection Ability to engage with different stakeholders within the criminal justice system, government functionaries and civil society Documentation of ongoing work of the project Process documentation Writing and timely submission of reports to funding agencies Coordinating with the field team to collate data and maintaining the data on monthly basis Case documentation Writing concept notes and proposals to funding agencies Content creation on social media handles of Prayas; additionally, managing and overseeing social media platforms and engagement. Preparing Prayas newsletters and helping with writing reports of research studies. Coordination of content production, including podcasts, short films, and related media.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Since applications received may be short-listed, merely possessing the prescribed qualifications and the requisite experience would not entitle a person to be called for the interview. Candidates will be informed over e-mail to appear for the Personal Interaction to be conducted at TISS, Mumbai. Request for ONLINE Personal Interaction will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are announced under TISS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 02 vacancies are available, comprising 01 post of Senior Research Officer and 01 post of Senior Documentation and Communication officer.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for TISS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of online application is 31st October, 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the posts?
faq.answer: Candidates with a M.Phil or Ph.D. or those nearing completion of their Ph.D. are preferred, along with at least 3 years of relevant experience in the field of criminal justice / social work with marginalised populations.

faq.question: Q4. What is the monthly remuneration for these posts?
faq.answer: Both positions carry a remuneration of Rs 70,000/- per month, which is inclusive of Travelling Allowance.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for TISS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500/- for general candidates, Rs. 125/- for SC/ST/PWD candidates with required certificates, and waived for women applicants.

faq.question: Q6. Are these permanent or contractual jobs?
faq.answer: These positions are on a contractual basis for 12 months under Prayas, a field action project of the Centre for Criminology and Justice, School of Social Work, TISS, Mumbai.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Candidates will be shortlisted and called for a Personal Interaction to be conducted at TISS, Mumbai.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates attend the interview online?
faq.answer: No, request for ONLINE Personal Interaction will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q9. Can an applicant apply for both positions?
faq.answer: Yes, but candidate must submit separate application for each position applied for.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are needed at the time of the personal interview?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates are requested to bring XEROX copies of relevant Certificates of Educational Qualifications, Work Experience & ID Proof (Self attested) along with Original documents for verification, and a 'No Objection Certificate' if under employment.
